title: Open Water
description: A real-time ocean simulated entirely on the GPU: Tessendorf FFT waves in three cascades, whitecap foam from wave-fold detection, a single-scattering atmosphere, sun glitter and moonlit nights, from calm to gale. One self-contained file, no libraries, no assets. Inspired by Leon Lin's open-water (github.com/Leonxlnx/open-water).
